pull.title: quirks: add 47 Sony camera entries (DSC, DSLR-A, Alpha/ZV/FX PC Remote)
pull.body:
## Summary

Add 47 comprehensive Sony (VID 0x054c) camera entries sourced from libgphoto2 `camlibs/ptp2/library.c` research.

### Classic DSC compacts (26 entries)
DSC-F828, DSC-R1, DSC-T9, DSC-H1, DSC-T10, DSC-T100, DSC-W100, DSC-H2, DSC-H5, DSC-H3, DSC-H7, DSC-H9, DSC-T2, DSC-T200, DSC-W170, DSC-H10, DSC-W120, DSC-W150, DSC-W300, DSC-T77, DSC-T90, DSC-T900, DSC-H20, DSC-H50, DSC-T300, DSC-T700

### DSLR-A / SLT / NEX series (9 entries)
DSLR-A230, A330, A380, A850, A550, A500, A450, SLT-A33, NEX-3

### Modern Alpha / ZV / Cinema PC Remote PIDs (12 entries)
- **Alpha**: ILCE-7RM5 (A7R V) ×2, ILCE-7CM2 (A7C II) ×2, ILCE-7CR (A7CR), ILCE-6700 (A6700), ILCE-9M3 (A9 III)
- **ZV**: ZV-E1 alt PID, ZV-1 II (ZV-1M2), ZV-1F
- **Cinema**: FX30 PC Remote, FX6

### Verification
- All entries: `category=camera`, `hooks=[]`, `status=proposed`, `confidence=medium`
- PTP interface: class 0x06, subclass 0x01, protocol 0x01
- **Zero duplicate VID:PID pairs** — verified programmatically
- Both `Specs/quirks.json` and `SwiftMTPKit/Sources/SwiftMTPQuirks/Resources/quirks.json` updated and identical
